articles.title: LA Kings Announce Hockey Operations Staff Additions for 2026-27 Season
LA Kings Loan Forward Jared Wright To AHL's Ontario Reign

away.summary: The Edmonton Oilers are riding a four-game winning streak and aim for a fifth straight win on their road trip. Captain Connor McDavid will play in his 800th career NHL game and leads the league with 13 points (3G, 10A) through five games. Forward Owen Michaels has been reliable in the faceoff circle despite limited experience.

home.summary: The Los Angeles Kings have lost four consecutive games to start the 2026-27 season, including an overtime loss to Vegas. They have loaned forward Jared Wright to the AHL's Ontario Reign and will host the Oilers tomorrow evening. The team has made several hockey operations staff additions for the 2026-27 season.
